g.text: Review the inline Airlock findings on this component.
Remove the secret; source it from a secrets manager / environment at runtime.
Migrate to safetensors, which stores tensors without executable opcodes.
Pin the exact version (and a hash where possible).
Confirm the license and its compatibility with your intended use.
Document the dataset's source, license, and consent basis.
Publish and load a safetensors version of these weights.
Move prompts to versioned template files with stable identifiers.
Address the GOVERN-mapped findings and document the control.
Address the MAP-mapped findings and document the control.
Address the MEASURE-mapped findings and document the control.
Obtain and verify checksums (or a signature) for the weight files before loading.
Prefer models that ship a populated README/model card describing provenance.
